hashScope: All production src .ts/.tsx (excluding tests), package.json and lockfile, normalized LF. Harness includes runner, preparation, spatial/lineage observers, reporting and performance/coaching/hold scripts.
allowedPostValidationSourceChange: Only the literal DEFAULT_DECISION_POLICY selection may change after evaluation. candidateHash normalizes that single literal and must remain identical. No policy/coach/physics/observer tuning is permitted. Any behavioural repair needs unused inputs.

cohort.primary: All twelve pr182-sealed designs, four SS, four SW, four WW; all five policies per exact transformed starting state.
cohort.additional: Do not decode or run pr180-reserved designs from the older archive. They are not confirmation in this PR.
cohort.unit: Fixture design; 12 paired units, not 60 independent matches or individual actions/frames.
cohort.transform: Attach canonical manager profile from each archived session; initialise empty coach observation and common collective roles. Preserve archived native attributes, physical bodies, formations, named benches, seed and laws. Hash complete transformed state and session before policy override.

budgets.correctness: Run the original full npm run verify without skipping suites or weakening assertions/timeouts; allow 30 minutes for the full command.
budgets.performance: Twenty serial 120s windows (two per policy/source), three complete matched role-policy before/after workloads, and separate observer on/off window; no other simulation/test workers during serial trials.

metrics.official: Canonical physical shots, goals, pass attempts/completions, possession, corners, cards, offside, tackles/interceptions and substitution facts. Crosses are not silently added to pass attempts.
metrics.flow: Unique first-time IDs, actual receptions/errors, possession durations, maximum/strict pathological holds, forward/final-third/box progression, natural restart and live/dead clock reconciliation.
metrics.spatial: Public line gaps/shape exposure, depth targets and actual >0.5m beyond-release-line completions, wing intentions and actual marker passage, overlaps, box occupation, cross execution/receiver geometry, aerial opportunities versus actual body-contested contact and second balls.
metrics.tactics: Role suitability/compatibility, changed/no-change decisions, halftime, score/dismissal and flank responses, role-sensitive legal changes, physical post-change movement and 30-second windows; controlled paired A-F continuations support local mechanism claims.
metrics.consequences: Pass/shot/keeper lineage, turnover location and subsequent ten-second opponent shots, actual controlled counterattack progress; useful failed attacking risk is not an automatic regression.
metrics.uncertainty: Paired fixture differences against legacy, all rows and strength strata, separate SW strong/weak sides; fixed-seed 4000-resample design bootstrap 95% intervals, exploratory and unadjusted for multiple endpoints.

hardGates: Selected policy completes every primary fixture; no unexplained contact/ownership, law, clock, canonical event or career-result failure.
Determinism, complete-state observer equality, human authority and exactly-once career checks pass.

No reproducible unopposed physically executable stationary no-op sink lasting >120s with available meaningful alternatives. Strict >=30s holds and drift beyond the strict detector are still inspected and reported.

Selected role policy complete serial CPU workload is no more than 35% above the same policy on PR181. A slower candidate remains experimental; no physics/tick reduction hides cost. Single workload uncertainty is disclosed.
football: A role candidate must improve actual shots and box progression over legacy in at least eight of twelve paired designs on each endpoint, without hiding failed weak-team fixtures.
Inspect depth reception, wing play, role/movement coherence, defending/cover, conversion and natural restarts together. More completion, wins, goals or event volume alone cannot win.

Compare nondominated eligible role candidates directly. Prefer fewer substantial no-op holds and coherent progression/variation; consider cost within the gate. Report disagreements/uncertainty rather than manufacture a scalar score.
Strong preference for provisional player-facing promotion when correctness/cost gates and credible overall improvement support it. Legacy attacking inactivity is a weakness, not a reason for inertia.
knownDevelopmentLimits: High SS circulation, weak-team technical errors, rare contested aerial contacts, excessive live time and uncalibrated goal-proxy expectations.

New WW frozen hold survives the 30-second R3 continuation under the strict <1m detector; other policies move out or change ownership. This remains a disclosed candidate warning, not an erased regression.
selection.readiness: READY / CONDITIONALLY READY / NOT READY refers to trust for later statistical summary calibration; provisional playability and a default promotion do not prove calibration.
selection.hybrid: No new hybrid is proposed; compare the five existing policy architectures on shared coaching/physics.
